summary: V3-08 repair cycle NOT accepted. The cycle objective was to repair the trusted finalizer failure from Actions run 35552961193 (step 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path' of the release job failed after 27m16s, 02:28:18 to 02:55:34 UTC, while the 'Trusted product, privacy and cost gates' step passed). The candidate contains NO delta: /home/runner/work/_temp/candidate-builder/metadata.json reports changedFiles=0, hasDelta=false, verificationOnly=true, agentExitCode=0; candidate.patch is 0 bytes; the working tree diff vs the pristine accepted tree (/home/runner/work/_temp/accepted-pristine) shows only untracked .expo/ and .opencode/ tooling directories. Trusted verification exit code is 0 (reports/audits/TRUSTED_35555772885.md: typecheck PASS, 451/451 tests PASS in 22 suites, privacy 71/71 PASS, cost gate 21/21 PASS, expo export android PASS, prebuild PASS, assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 19m20s), but verify-product.sh does NOT exercise the failing step: it never runs the emulator E2E golden path, assembleRelease, or the iOS export. The emulator E2E step has failed 15 consecutive dispatched finalizer runs (35552961193, 35544223219, 35530222887, 35521604346, 35515804944, 35505122996, 35496233889, 35490543018, 35485115705, 35476794686, 35470723768, 35464672760, 35457974999, 35451816114, 35445913329, 35437961965), all at the same step, while the gates step (including assembleRelease and iOS export) passes; scheduled finalizer runs are no-ops (release skipped). Because the candidate makes no change that can affect the failing step, the next finalizer run would fail identically: the release-level mustFix 'Trusted V3 finalizer failed' remains unaddressed. Independent verification confirms the golden-path UI elements all exist in the app (Demarrer (demo) in app/index.tsx; tabs Ajouter/Balances/A faire in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx; demo fixture Appartement, Vaisselle du soir, Sortir les poubelles in src/features/app/demoFixture.ts; member names Alex/Sam rendered via memberName in app/(tabs)/balances.tsx; section titles Contribution/Argent present), and the app loading path is robust (in-memory repository fallback, reposReady gating, bounded SQLite window), so the persistent failure is a runtime/E2E-environment blocker, not missing UI. A plausible systematic cause remains in the tree: scripts/e2e-android.js waitFor() force-stops and relaunches the app after STUCK_APP_THRESHOLD=4 consecutive real uiautomator dumps with no label match; on a slow API 35 x86_64 emulator the documented cold start can reach 240s and each dump takes 30-60s, so 4 dumps (2-4 min) can elapse while a healthy app is still cold-starting, causing the detector to kill the app before 'Demarrer (demo)' renders and resetting the cold start each time. The next cycle must read the step-7 evidence of run 35552961193 (logcat-wait-*.txt, logcat-failure.txt, dump-*.xml, step logs via the factory token) and repair the concrete runtime/E2E blocker (e.g., time-based stuck detection, higher threshold, or no force-stop while the app process is alive and dumps are healthy), preserving V3-01..V3-07. Decision: repair.
